promo.title: Recommended: GitCC API
promo.description: Built-in text models GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.4 (custom models can be added); built-in image model Qwen Image 2.0; video defaults to Doubao Seedance 2.0 Fast, plus Sora-2 (custom models can be added). Stable, fast, and affordably priced. This open-source project is powered by GitCC API.

apiKey.helper: The global API Key is used for all model calls. You can also configure a separate API Key for individual providers.
apiKey.placeholderUseGlobal: Leave blank to use the global API Key
apiKey.missing: API Key is missing. Please set an API Key in Model Config.

notes.title: Configuration Notes
notes.item1: The global API Key is used for all built-in GitCC API models
notes.item2: You can adjust model parameters (temperature, tokens, etc.) for each model category
notes.item3: Supports adding custom models that use other API services
notes.item4: All configuration is only saved in your local browser and is never uploaded to a server
